Hero.headline: DANIEL ARIAS:
Hero.sub: Redefining the cello through the lens of modern vanguardism and symphonic legacy.

Artist.label: BIOGRAPHY
Artist.heading: ENGINEERING SOUND
Artist.body1: Daniel Arias is a Venezuelan cellist based in Europe, internationally recognized as a soloist, chamber musician, and stage artist. Trained through El Sistema and further refined in France and Germany, he has performed in major venues across Europe, the Americas, and Asia alongside renowned musicians and international orchestras.
Artist.body2: Known for the emotional intensity of his performances and his charismatic stage presence, Daniel Arias blends the tradition of classical music with a contemporary artistic vision, bringing the cello closer to new generations and audiences around the world.
Artist.body3: And this is just the beginning of his journey.
